object_description: sculptural monolithic longitudinal solitaire with recesses, incisions and courtyards
geometry_property: simple form with recesses and incisions
design_condition: the monolith is placed along the street forming a square with the existing buildings to the north, while on the west and north the natural outdoor space runs directly up to the building on a uniform base plate

positive: The simple form of the solitaire convinces with recesses and incisions in a well-proportioned and precise position
The volume is characterised by the simplicity of the openings and needs no appendages such as arcades or balconies
The scale of access and use is well maintained internally and externally
The structure forms a square with the existing buildings to the north
The natural outdoor space leads directly to the building on the west and north facades
Nature and man-made structure collide, made tangible by the theme of the uniform base plate
The sculptural form with courtyards and loggia-like openings detaches micro-landscapes from the overall context
The authors take up the floodplain theme and develop it for rainwater management and design
The main entrance is in a recessed, weather-protected area
Circulation develops along and around two- to three-storey atriums
The meandering circulation generates a variety of learning areas on each floor
Vertical access is via three open stairwells illuminated by skylights
The clusters are clearly delineated and connected in an interesting and exciting way
The location of hall, library, kindergarten and day structure gives good separation for evening and weekend use
Spatial relationships work horizontally and vertically through open stairwells and green atriums
The relationship between the classrooms and the outdoor space is good, separated only by a staircase
The allocation of uses is good and meets the expectations of the school
The hall closes the south side simply, with an outdoor area above, separate access and lockable outside school hours
The structural design is simple, clear and well solved
The detailing shows a well-considered design in exposed concrete with wooden infills
The project is well embedded and brings a great deal of calm to the heterogeneous existing buildings
High architectural quality that is simple, clear and functional
negative: Whether the multi-layered floodplain theme suits this small-scale, isolated task remains questionable
The usability and attractiveness of the learning areas are in part severely restricted by the circulation area
The organisation with three stairwells is questionable and very complex
The quality of lighting via the atriums on the lower two floors is questionable
The outdoor court above the gymnasium has disadvantages compared to a ground-level arrangement
The internal circulation with its meandering movement, learning zones and lighting is not entirely convincing
The clustering of uses is not entirely convincing, particularly on the upper floors
